title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 2:13-23
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 2:13-23</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="13" /> And after they departed, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">a messenger of the Lord</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">shone-in-appearance</char> to Ioseph <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">in a dream</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">Getting up, take</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and his mother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and flee <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">to Egypt</char> and be there until whenever I speak to you! 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          For <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Herodes</char> is about <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">to seek</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char>, to destroy him.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="14" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">getting up, he took</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and his mother</char> by night, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">he departed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">to Egypt</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="15" /> and he was there until <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">the death-end of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">in order to</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">fill-full</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">From Egypt</char> I called <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">my son</char>.” 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="16" /> Then <char word-lang="greek" word-original="τοτε"></char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, seeing that he had been deceptively-tricked by the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise">magi</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        he was enraged, very much, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and having sent, he did away with all <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the children</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        who were in Bethle’em and in all its districts, 
      </group>
      <group>
        from two years old and below, 
      </group>
      <group>
        according to the time which he learned precisely from the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise">magi</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">Then</char> <char word-lang="greek" word-original="τοτε"> </char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">was</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">filled-full</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">what was spoken through Ieremias the prophet, saying</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <verse number="18" /> “A voice was heard in Rama, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        crying and great grieving; 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        Rakhel crying for <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">her children</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and she does not want to be comforted, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        because they are no more.” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="19" /> And after <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Herodes</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">came to his death-end</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">a messenger of the Lord</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">shone-in-appearance</char> to Ioseph <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">in Egypt</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">in a dream</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="20" /> “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">Getting up, take the child and his mother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and go</char> to the land of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">Israel</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          for those <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">who seek</char> the life of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char> have <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">died</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="21" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">getting up, he took the child and his mother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and he went</char> to the land of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">Israel</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="22" /> and having heard that <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Arkhelaos ruled as king</char> of Ioudaia, 
        </group>
        <group>
          in the place of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">his father Herodes</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he was afraid and he left there, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and having been warned <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">in a dream</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">he departed</char> into the region of Galilaia, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="23" /> and having come, he lived in a city called “Nazaret,” 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">in order to</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">fill-full</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">what was spoken through the prophets</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          that he would be called a Nazoraios.” 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
